title: Synthetic session expiry migration and dependency update
body:
## Summary
Add expiry timestamps to stored sessions and update the fictional storage dependency used by this demo.
## Testing
The example migration is reviewed against an isolated fixture with existing sessions; no real service or dependency is changed.
## Dependency rationale
The fictional storage update supplies the timestamp binding needed by this example migration.
## Migration
Add a nullable expiry column before backfilling existing sessions; older readers continue to work while the application is upgraded.
## Rollout
Back up session data and validate the backfill in staging. Roll back application reads before removing the newly added column.
